name: – Niclas Herbst – § 49, after point xii – Am 74
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2023, Section III – Commission, executive agencies and the ninth, tenth and eleventh European Development Funds
part_text: (xii a) immediately suspend or cancel grant agreements with NGOs that are in violation of the financial rules of the Union and to supplement the Commission guidance with concrete proposals for avoiding Union funding being used to actively lobby Union institutions, such as self-declarations; welcomes the announcements made by the new Commission in this regard;
